## Direction of arrival (SRP-PHAT + stabiliser). Pure C: the host harness in
## tools/doa_harness compiles the same sources for x86.
add_library(fph_doa_srp INTERFACE)
target_sources(fph_doa_srp
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/doa_srp.c
)
target_include_directories(fph_doa_srp
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/api
)
target_link_libraries(fph_doa_srp
    INTERFACE
        lib_xcore_math
)

## src/doa_srp_tables.h is generated by gen_tables.py and committed; every build
## re-runs the generator in --check mode and stops if the header is stale.
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
add_custom_target(fph_doa_srp_tables_check
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/gen_tables.py --check
    COMMENT "Checking doa_srp_tables.h against gen_tables.py"
    VERBATIM
)
add_dependencies(fph_doa_srp fph_doa_srp_tables_check)

## Create an alias
add_library(fph::doa_srp ALIAS fph_doa_srp)
